courses.title: Yoga für Schwangere
courses.description: A weekly evening class at the Munich centre for pregnant women, with classical Sivananda postures adapted for pregnancy, breathing exercises and relaxation, guided by a qualified teacher. Recommended from the fourth month; the centre asks for a doctor's confirmation before joining.

left_out: Zweijährige Yogalehrer-Ausbildung: the Munich site only links out to sivananda.at (the Tyrol ashram runs it), so it is not the Munich centre's own offering.

Gesundheit und Hatha Yoga ('Hatha Yoga Inspirationen', live online with Swami Sivadasananda): enrolment goes to the Reith (Tyrol) ashram office, so it is run by the network rather than the Munich centre; the current block (28 Oct to 1 Dec 2026) has also started. No cure claim on the page (theme: rest and better sleep).
Ayurveda ('Ayurveda-Kochen mit S. K. Kamlesh'): the page is for a 2022 course, past.
Kinderyoga: originally left out as outside the core offer, not for health; not reopened.
flags: Yoga für Schwangere: the page lists benefits such as easing pregnancy stress and strengthening the body, and asks for a doctor's confirmation before joining (it supports medical care). No claim to cure or treat. The page text says Wednesdays 18.00-19.30 while its meta description says Fridays; the description leaves the day out.
Price shown as '22 €, ermäßigt: 15 €' with no currency code.
